fusions.name: Grit Scatter
fusions.desc: Looses 4 shards of gravel at once, spread apart, each dealing 8 damage and knocking its target back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Dense Slug
fusions.desc: Fires a dense stone slug that deals 40 damage, rising to twice that at its full reach of 11 tiles. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Firing Pit
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to raise a stone emplacement that lasts 12 seconds and fires on an enemy within 6 tiles for 5 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Rifled Bore
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
